verdict.rationale: Backtesting rules is a fair question for a fraud-prevention platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that Decision Center policies can be configured at the Sale checkpoint and applied to live orders. Nothing in the pack shows replaying a rule against historical traffic or reporting what it would have blocked, flagged, or cost.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, I can backtest a rule against my historical traffic before deploying it, seeing exactly what it would have blocked, flagged, and cost
